carpet.rule.easyPlaceProtocolExtra.name: Easy Place Protocol V2-Extra
carpet.rule.easyPlaceProtocolExtra.desc: Enables the server-side V2-Extra easy-place handshake and block-state synchronization. Client functionality is not included.
carpet.rule.playerLadder.name: Player Ladder
carpet.rule.playerLadder.desc: Master switch for the Player Ladder feature. When off, right-clicking an entity does nothing.
carpet.rule.playerLadderClickMode.name: Player Ladder Click Mode
carpet.rule.playerLadderClickMode.desc: What a right click on an entity does: ride it, pick it up, or nothing. Values: ride, pick_up, none.
carpet.rule.playerLadderPickupDepthLimit: Maximum stacked passenger depth searched when picking up an entity.
carpet.rule.playerLadderRideDepthLimit.d: Maximum stacked passenger depth searched when riding an entity.
Whether entities other than players can be ridden or picked up.
Comma separated entity ids or tags (prefix with #) that can never be ridden or picked up.
carpet.rule.playerLadderDismountOnGameMo: Player Ladder Dismount On Game Mode Change
Whether passengers are dismounted when the carrier changes game mode.
carpet.rule.playerLadderAllowRiderStacki: Whether stacks of 3 or more players are allowed. When false, only two players may ride each other.
carpet.rule.playerLadderAllowFakePlayers: Whether Carpet fake players can be ridden or picked up.
Client side aiming fix that keeps riders selectable while stacked. Client only.
